finding: Validated claim-state transitions require an append-only atomic persistence boundary; validation alone cannot prevent two writers from replacing the same active claim head.

implemented_contract.head_binding: Each claim head stores transition_id, transition_digest, next_state, and observed_at.
implemented_contract.stale_writer_behavior: A transition whose prior_transition_digest does not equal the current claim head fails closed before persistence.
implemented_contract.collision_behavior: Two writers sharing one backend may not both append different transitions from the same prior head.
implemented_contract.idempotency: An identical transition_id and transition_digest retry returns idempotent without appending a duplicate record.
implemented_contract.history_policy: Transitions are appended; prior transition records are never replaced or deleted.

verification.environment: isolated Node runtime using byte-identical candidate module and test content
verified_cases: first append plus identical retry idempotency
two-writer collision permits one durable head only
stale prior digest fails closed before persistence

privacy_boundary: Only opaque claim identifiers, repository locators, transition metadata, and verification results are persisted. No private chat text, personal events, health data, credentials, or account data are included.

falsification_route: Run two independent OS processes against one production atomic backend using the same claim head and different next transitions; exactly one transition may persist and a fresh read must show one append-only head.
